SPECIAL BRANCH REGISTRY.
File No. S. O. 544.

SUBJECT

Report re A/ Ettinger & Rufio buying
matter for making explosives.
pages.zh:
特别处档案室。
档案编号 S. O. 544。

事由

关于 A/ Ettinger 与 Rufio 购买制造炸药原料事宜的报告。

pages.en:
No.
544
2/10/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
October 2nd 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
Josefi reported to me at 12 noon on Sept. 30th
that he had information to the effect that Ettinger
and Rufio were buying or rather trying to buy
potassium chloride, liquid ammonia, Harz pulver
Salicyanic acid, crude sulphur and phosphorous
with the object of making explosives of some kind.
The potassium chloride can, it is stated, be
easily obtained, but neither Ettinger nor Rufio could
discover ammonia in any of the shops which was up
to the strength required (90%)?
A Japanese has been enlisted to help in buying the
articles. His name and address Josefi is endeavouring to
ascertain.
Josefi alleges that he shadowed Ettinger or Rufio
along various streets on the night of the 29th but that
at 8.30 p.m. they somehow disappeared and he lost all
trace of him.
Ettinger according to the same informer has recently
received a copy of a Mussalman document from Constantinople
which proclaims a Holy War. This is being reproduced by
some printer whose identity Josefi is attempting to discover.
Your Obedient Servant,
mmunitions O.D.I.

（批：
A.E.
for yr. informn.
JPD
2/10.
OAH
）
pages.zh:
编号
544
1916年10月2日
上海工部局。
1916年10月2日
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生，
Josefi 于9月30日中午12时向我报告，
他获得情报称，Ettinger
和 Rufio 正在购买，或者更确切地说是试图购买
氯化钾、液氨、Harz pulver（原文不清）、
水杨酸、粗硫磺和磷，
目的是制造某种炸药。
据称，氯化钾可以
轻易获得，但 Ettinger 和 Rufio 均未能
在任何商店中找到符合所需浓度（90%）的氨水？
已招募一名日本人协助购买这些物品。
Josefi 正努力查明其姓名和地址。
Josefi 声称，他在29日晚沿多条街道跟踪 Ettinger 或 Rufio，
但在晚上8点30分，他们不知何故消失了，他失去了所有踪迹。
据同一线人称，Ettinger 最近收到了一份来自君士坦丁堡的穆斯林文件副本，
该文件宣布进行圣战。此文件正由某印刷商翻印，
Josefi 正试图查明该印刷商的身份。
您忠实的仆人，
mmunitions O.D.I.

（批注：
A.E.
供你参考。
JPD
10月2日。
OAH
）
